fields.Name: T358 - Open Recording Synchronized Playback
fields.Description: The core value path unique to this dashboard: SelectSession() loads transcript turns via a second RunView on 'MJ: Conversation Details', builds time-aligned MediaTranscriptCues, and hands FileID + cues to mj-storage-media-player — not reachable through any generic grid/form flow.

InputDefinition.goal: In the 'Realtime Recordings' application (reach it via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo), wait for the recordings list to load — pages can take 10-30s in this environment, so wait, don't navigate away. If at least one recording row is present, click it and wait for the right-hand playback pane to load; success is that the detail pane mounts an audio/media player (play controls / scrubber) together with a transcript view, or shows a 'Loading recording...' then the player. If the list is empty, seeing the 'No recorded sessions yet' empty state is also a pass. You do NOT need to actually hear audio play — the player and transcript rendering is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking a recording row loads the right playback pane with a media/audio player (play button or scrubber visible) and/or a transcript panel — OR a valid empty state if no recordings exist
The previously-shown 'Select a session to replay' prompt is replaced by the player once a recording is selected
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
